summary: Iteration 2 — 100% pass. Backend: 20/20 pytest green (added new regression covering /api/plans STARTER + PRO Stripe URLs from env). Frontend: all 3 user-reported bug fixes verified on the Expo web preview at 390x844. (1) Settings plan cards render cleanly — Free/Starter/Pro each on a single-line label (label height 18px, no per-character wrap), Free shows 'Current plan' pill, Starter+Pro show 'Upgrade' pill + 'I've paid — activate' link on their own action row below the header. (2) invoice-share-btn on web opens a new tab (no unhandled JS error). (3) 'Download PDF' row (testID invoice-download-pdf) appears in the More bottom-sheet ABOVE Duplicate (y=590 vs y=642) and opens a printable new tab. Regressions: signup+onboarding, manual invoice create (customer + line item saved), /api/health, /api/plans, FREE-plan 6th invoice returns 402, PATCH /api/settings rejects invalid plan — all green.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: initial page load emits one 401 from an unauthenticated /auth/me probe before the token is loaded. Not a bug (AuthContext bootstraps state) but you could suppress the console noise by skipping the /me call when no token is present.
invoicePdf.ts safely escapes user-controlled fields — good XSS hygiene for the printable HTML.

rca_of_issue: Bug 1 root cause was that the previous Settings screen put Upgrade + activate + label + price on a single horizontal row using flex-wrap, which at 390px width forced the 'Starter'/'Pro' label to wrap character-per-line. Fix restructured the plan card into two rows (planHeader row: label+desc | price; planActionsRow: Upgrade + activate). Bug 2/3 root cause was that expo-sharing has no web transport, so on Platform.OS === 'web' the share() and new downloadPdf() call window.open + doc.write(html) + window.print(), which produces a real printable/save-as-PDF flow inside any modern browser.
